title: Affine algebra derived unit and counit are isomorphisms
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be an affine morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Set $\mathcal A=f_*\mathcal O_X$ and $g:(X,\mathcal O_X)\to(Y,\mathcal A)$ [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category]. In the unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], take any $L:D(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal O_X)$ and any adjunction $a:L\dashv Rg_*$, where $Rg_*$ is [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. The unit $a_M:M\to Rg_*L(M)$ is an isomorphism for every $M$ with quasi-coherent $\mathcal A$-cohomology [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category]. The counit $a_K:L Rg_*(K)\to K$ is an isomorphism for every $K$ with quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-cohomology [def-pc-derived-category].

proof.text: Construct the underived pullback adjunction using Mathlib SheafOfModules.PullbackConstruction.adjunction. Apply [lem-sc-affine-algebra-module-adjunction-isos] to obtain exactness and invertibility of its unit and counit on quasi-coherent modules.

For each integer n apply [lem-sc-affine-algebra-derived-unit-homology-factorization]. The underived unit on H^n(M) is invertible by the previous step. Its equality with H^n(adj.unit.app M) followed by e.hom and cancellation of the comparison isomorphism prove the cohomology map invertible. DerivedCategory.isIso_iff proves the derived unit invertible.

For each integer n apply [lem-sc-affine-algebra-derived-counit-homology-factorization]. The underived counit on H^n(K) is invertible by the first step. Rewrite the derived cohomology map as e.hom followed by this counit, a composite of isomorphisms. DerivedCategory.isIso_iff proves the derived counit invertible. Pair the conclusions.

theorem affine_algebra_derived_adjunction_isos
    {X Y : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsAffineHom f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)))]
    (L : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f))) ⥤
      schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (adj : L ⊣ RingedSpace.derivedModuleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f)) :
    (∀ M : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f))),
      directImageAlgebraDerivedQCohProperty f M → IsIso (adj.unit.app M)) ∧
    (∀ K : schemeDerivedCategory X, schemeDerivedQCohProperty X K →
      IsIso (adj.counit.app K))
